ios.desc:
THE PROFESSIONAL IPAD GAME ENGINE
Make real games with visual Behaviors. Design, build, test, and publish complete 2D games with a game development environment built specifically for iPad.

Build and own your games, share them with players, and export to Xcode when you're ready to publish on the App Store.

BUILD WITH VISUAL BEHAVIORS
Create gameplay using hyperPad’s visual Behavior system. Connect events, actions, conditions, variables, arrays, loops, timers, physics, UI, audio, and reusable logic without writing traditional code.

Build enemy AI, inventory systems, menus, animations, scoring systems, save data, camera controls, object spawning, and more.

A COMPLETE 2D GAME STUDIO
Build your game from idea to playable project directly on iPad:
• Visual Behavior-based game logic
• Scene and level design
• Real-time playtesting
• Physics and collision systems
• Particle effects and shaders
• Animation, UI, and audio tools
• Multiplayer and networking
• Prefabs and reusable systems
• Import graphics, animations, audio, music, and fonts
• Ad monetization support
• Xcode export for App Store publishing
• Community sharing and player feedback

BUILT FOR IPAD
hyperPad is a native iPad game development experience. Not a desktop game engine adapted for mobile.

Create with touch, Apple Pencil, keyboard, trackpad, and gestures. Build and test on the same device so you can quickly move from an idea to a playable game.

BUILD MORE THAN SIMPLE GAMES
Create platformers, RPGs, arcade games, adventures, physics games, rhythm games, simulations, educational experiences, interactive stories, prototypes, and original 2D games.

Combine variables, arrays, loops, physics, prefabs, shaders, networking, and reusable Behavior systems to build increasingly sophisticated projects.

LEARN GAME DEVELOPMENT BY MAKING GAMES
New to game development? Learn programming and game design concepts visually through hands-on creation.
Work with events, conditions, variables, loops, object systems, physics, debugging, and problem-solving while seeing the results directly in your game.
Experienced creators can use the same visual systems to prototype ideas, create reusable systems, and build complete game projects.

CREATE. TEST. SHARE. PUBLISH.
Design your game on iPad.
Build gameplay with visual Behaviors.
Test instantly.
Share to the hyperPad Hub for playtesting and feedback.
Improve your project.
Export to Xcode when you're ready to prepare it for the App Store.
